title: Haye Veeraan Gharaan Vich Rovay Beemar Khari
body:
Aisi Vichree Na Mili Fer Ali Akbar Nu Kadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Veer Vichray Na Kisay Bhen Da Akbar Vangoon x2
Maut Ban Janda Eh Eh Roug Dukhi Bheinaan Di
<<DIVIDER>>
Aja Pardesiya Veera Meh Tere Rah Vekhaan x2
Jora Shagnaan Da Banaya Meh Veeran Tere Layee
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasida Javeen Te Akbar Nu Kaveen Ro Ro Ke x2
Sahvaan Gindee Hoyee Hamsheer Nu Mil Ja Cheti
<<DIVIDER>>
Meh Haan Beemar Veeran Keevain Teray Kol Aavan x2
Waat Karbal Di Medinay Ton Eh Dushwaar Bari
<<DIVIDER>>
Jyoondi Mar Javay Gi Sughra Ne Jadon Ay Suneya x2
Kha Gayi Akbar De Kalayjay Nu Zulam Di Barchi
<<DIVIDER>>
Khair Hovay Teri Akbar Meh Duavaan Kardee x2
Toon Te Dasveen Nu Veeran Layn Menu Aona Si
<<DIVIDER>>
Naal Asghar Nu Vi Leh Avay Je Alma Vala x2
Fer Meh Jaan Na Devaan Kadee Saree Zindagi
<<DIVIDER>>
Allah Janay Keevain Nibh Gayee Eh Di Kaleyaan Akhtar
Jaag Ke Raatan Guzaray Sain Khaabaan Di Dari
